rows.text: In one sentence, what is the point of a dead-man switch on a robot?
rows.reply: A dead-man switch requires continuous operator engagement and immediately halts the robot's motion when released, ensuring it stops if the operator loses control or becomes incapacitated.

rows.text: What is one risk of running lidar in direct sunlight?
rows.reply: Direct sunlight can saturate the lidar sensor or create glare, causing false readings or dropout, which is why we track lidar performance in bright conditions.

rows.text: What is a good rule of thumb for the number of test cycles before a firmware release?
rows.reply: A good rule of thumb is to complete at least 10,000 full operational cycles—or 3× the expected worst-case daily cycles—before a firmware release, with any safety or regression failure blocking sign-off.
